frame.title: Healthy vs Unhealthy Nodes by Region
Latency vs Packet Loss (by Node Type)

datasets.name: ds_regional_latest
datasets.query: SELECT region_code, avg_health_score, active_nodes, healthy_node_count, unhealthy_node_count, region_avg_throughput_mbps, region_avg_latency_ms, region_avg_packet_loss_pct, region_total_connected_users, region_total_errors FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_regional_network_summary WHERE measurement_date = (SELECT MAX(measurement_date) FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_regional_network_summary)

datasets.name: ds_regional_trend
datasets.query: SELECT measurement_date, region_code, avg_health_score, region_avg_throughput_mbps, region_avg_latency_ms, region_total_errors FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_regional_network_summary ORDER BY measurement_date, region_code

datasets.name: ds_outage_summary
datasets.query: SELECT outage_date, region_code, severity, outage_count, total_affected_customers, avg_duration_minutes, total_outage_minutes, total_revenue_impact, dispatches_required, work_orders_created, ongoing_outages FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_outage_summary ORDER BY outage_date DESC

datasets.name: ds_root_cause
datasets.query: SELECT root_cause, severity, total_outages, total_affected_customers, avg_duration_minutes, median_duration_minutes, p95_duration_minutes, total_dispatches, dispatch_rate_pct, total_revenue_impact FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_outage_root_cause_analysis ORDER BY total_outages DESC

datasets.name: ds_node_health_buckets
datasets.query: SELECT CASE WHEN health_score >= 75 THEN 'Healthy (75+)' WHEN health_score >= 50 THEN 'Degraded (50-75)' WHEN health_score >= 25 THEN 'Poor (25-50)' ELSE 'Critical (<25)' END AS health_bucket, COUNT(*) AS node_count FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health WHERE measurement_date = (SELECT MAX(measurement_date) FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY node_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_node_perf_by_type
datasets.query: SELECT node_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_throughput_mbps), 1) AS avg_throughput, ROUND(AVG(avg_latency_ms), 1) AS avg_latency, ROUND(AVG(avg_packet_loss_pct), 3) AS avg_packet_loss FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health WHERE measurement_date = (SELECT MAX(measurement_date) FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health) GROUP BY node_type ORDER BY avg_throughput DESC

datasets.name: ds_throughput_trend
datasets.query: SELECT measurement_date, region_code, ROUND(region_avg_throughput_mbps, 1) AS avg_throughput_mbps FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_regional_network_summary ORDER BY measurement_date, region_code

datasets.name: ds_node_scatter
datasets.query: SELECT node_name, node_type, region_code, health_score, avg_latency_ms, avg_packet_loss_pct, avg_throughput_mbps, total_errors FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health WHERE measurement_date = (SELECT MAX(measurement_date) FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health)

datasets.name: ds_worst_nodes
datasets.query: SELECT node_name, node_type, region_code, vendor, health_score, ROUND(avg_throughput_mbps, 1) AS avg_throughput_mbps, ROUND(avg_latency_ms, 1) AS avg_latency_ms, total_errors, ROUND(peak_cpu_pct, 1) AS peak_cpu_pct FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health WHERE measurement_date = (SELECT MAX(measurement_date) FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_daily_node_health) ORDER BY health_score ASC LIMIT 25

datasets.name: ds_risk_distribution
datasets.query: SELECT risk_category, COUNT(*) AS node_count FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_node_maintenance_risk GROUP BY risk_category ORDER BY CASE risk_category WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

datasets.name: ds_risk_by_region
datasets.query: SELECT region_code, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_category = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_category = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_category = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_category = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_node_maintenance_risk GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY region_code

datasets.name: ds_risk_by_vendor
datasets.query: SELECT vendor, COUNT(*) AS node_count, ROUND(AVG(maintenance_risk_score), 1) AS avg_risk_score, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_category = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_count FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_node_maintenance_risk GROUP BY vendor ORDER BY avg_risk_score DESC

datasets.name: ds_age_risk
datasets.query: SELECT node_name, node_type, region_code, vendor, age_days, days_since_maintenance, maintenance_risk_score, risk_category, ROUND(recent_avg_health, 1) AS recent_avg_health FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_node_maintenance_risk

datasets.name: ds_critical_risk_nodes
datasets.query: SELECT node_name, node_type, region_code, vendor, age_days, days_since_maintenance, maintenance_risk_score, recent_avg_health, recent_outage_count FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_node_maintenance_risk WHERE risk_category IN ('critical', 'high') ORDER BY maintenance_risk_score DESC

datasets.name: ds_iot_health
datasets.query: SELECT infrastructure_id, device_count, avg_signal_dbm, avg_throughput_mbps, avg_latency_ms, avg_packet_loss_pct, avg_temperature_c, avg_battery_pct, total_connected_clients, total_errors, iot_health_score FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_iot_device_health

datasets.name: ds_iot_health_buckets
datasets.query: SELECT CASE WHEN iot_health_score >= 75 THEN 'Healthy (75+)' WHEN iot_health_score >= 50 THEN 'Degraded (50-75)' WHEN iot_health_score >= 25 THEN 'Poor (25-50)' ELSE 'Critical (<25)' END AS health_bucket, COUNT(*) AS asset_count FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_iot_device_health GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY asset_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_iot_worst
datasets.query: SELECT infrastructure_id, device_count, iot_health_score, avg_signal_dbm, avg_throughput_mbps, avg_battery_pct, total_errors, total_connected_clients FROM `{pipeline_catalog}`.network_data.gold_iot_device_health ORDER BY iot_health_score ASC LIMIT 20
